name: Clara's Letter to the Chronicle
description:
Found by Thomas in Arthur Crane's locked desk drawer.

A letter in Clara Hale's handwriting, dated three weeks before her death, addressed to the Editor of the Ashgate Chronicle.

It details Councillor Hargrove's housing conditions at Whitmore Street, names four witnesses by name, and includes copies of the testimonies. It ends:

'I trust the Chronicle to do what is right. These are real people. Please.'

The letter has been opened. It was never printed. It was never passed to anyone.
journal_entry: She trusted him. She trusted the paper. He had this the whole time and he said nothing to me. Not once.
